ur.title: RMU - Undergraduate admissions requirements (test-optional, program GPA minimums)

test_policy.notes: RMU has waived the standardized-test requirement for all programs for freshman applicants. Nursing admits directly with a 3.0 GPA plus SAT 1080+ or ACT 22+, or with a 3.4 GPA without scores. Preference for admission goes to a cumulative 3.0 GPA or higher; most majors can be decided from a self-reported GPA, confirmed later on the official transcript.

requirements.notes: Free online application at rmu.edu/apply (College Navigator showed a $30 fee for 2024-25). International freshmen send official secondary transcripts, English test scores (an SAT EBRW of 540+ may be accepted in lieu) and a passport copy. To be considered for a scholarship the applicant must send a NACES foreign transcript evaluation with a US GPA. After acceptance an enrollment deposit (waived with proof of a fully funded scholarship) unlocks the I-20 request.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Page says 'May 1 for Fall attendance and November 1 for Spring attendance' with no year; taken as fall 2027. The page does not say whether admission is rolling.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Applicants must submit an approved English exam (TOEFL, IELTS, PTE or Duolingo); an SAT EBRW score of 540 or higher may be accepted instead. Conditional admission or test waivers exist for students in partner programs: University of Pittsburgh English Language Institute (levels 5 or 6 with 85 percent in most courses and an 80 percent average) and ELS Language Center (Level 112); students still enrolled in those programs can be conditionally admitted and upgraded after finishing. No exemption by country is listed.

aid.notes: Academic scholarships are offered to undergraduate international students at the point of acceptance, based on weighted high school GPA (international freshmen): $28,000 for 3.8+, $26,000 for 3.40-3.79, $23,000 for 3.10-3.39, $19,000 for 2.70-3.09, $13,000 for 2.50-2.69, $11,000 below 2.50. The page does not label the amounts as per year; it says full-time students may keep institutional scholarships for up to four years with an overall 2.0 GPA (fully online students are not eligible). A NACES transcript evaluation with a US GPA is required if the transcript has none. No international need-based aid is described.

majors.notes: Direct admission with a 3.0 GPA, B or better in trigonometry or pre-calculus and a strong math and science background. Engineering tuition is higher ($20,400 per semester).
Direct admission with a 3.25 GPA and a B in trigonometry, pre-calculus or calculus.

Direct admission with a 3.0 GPA, SAT 1080+ or ACT 22+ and B or better in all math and science courses including chemistry with lab; without test scores a 3.4 GPA is needed. Nursing tuition is higher ($20,400 per semester).
Direct admission with a 3.2 GPA and a strong science background (Biology/Pre-Med needs 3.5).
